# Nebula Components

> Nebula Components provides landing page conversion diagnostics for founders spending on paid ads with low or zero conversions. (We are an audit platform for paid traffic landing pages, not a UI component library). The free audit identifies observable conversion leaks across 9 signals. The One-Leak Repair Sprint ($97) supplies a tailored change for one selected finding; the customer or their developer implements it.

Nebula Components checks what a paid visitor experiences: message match, trust, mobile CTA, load time, CTA clarity, above-fold clarity, ad signals, SEO foundations, and AI readiness. Each failing signal is tied to evidence from the actual page and ranked by likely impact. The score and initial findings appear before email; email unlocks the full report. No sales calls.

Target customer: founders actively spending on ads (Google, Meta, LinkedIn) who are not converting. The buying trigger is "spending on ads and not converting" - not a demographic filter.

Full expanded context: [llms-full.txt](https://nebulacomponents.com/llms-full.txt)

## Docs

The machine-readable contract behind every audit. Machine-readable version: https://nebulacomponents.com/spec/landing-page-diagnostic-v1.json
- [Signal reference pages](https://nebulacomponents.com/signals): One plain-language definition page per signal (message match, trust, mobile CTA, load speed, CTA clarity, above-fold clarity, ad signals, SEO foundations, AI readiness) with manual checks and pass/fail examples.
- [Pricing](https://nebulacomponents.com/pricing): One-Leak Repair Sprint $97 (locked through 2026-12-31)
- [Learning Centre](https://nebulacomponents.com/learning-centre): 41 articles on landing page conversion issues, paid traffic leaks, and ad-to-page diagnosis (each also available as markdown at /learning-centre/<slug>.md)
- [About](https://nebulacomponents.com/about): Founder and company background
- [Citable (open source)](https://nebulacomponents.com/resources/citable): Citable v1.14.0: Evidence layer for SEO, AEO, and GEO audits. 123 detectors across 18 namespaces and 27 schema-validated registries (not all detectors are deterministic - each declares its determinism posture). Apache 2.0. npm: @nebulacomponents/citable

## Agent tools (navigator.modelContext / WebMCP)

Nebula registers tools via `navigator.modelContext` on every page for browsers that support the Model Context Protocol:

- `analyze_page(url)` - Run a full 9-signal audit against a landing page URL. Returns pass/fail for each signal, evidence from the actual page HTML, and a specific fix. Use this to diagnose why a page is not converting.
- `get_audit_result(audit_id)` - Retrieve structured findings for a completed audit by ID.
- `get_signals()` - Return the 9 signals checked, what each measures, and the manual equivalent time (15–25 minutes in DevTools vs under 30 seconds with Nebula).
- `get_pricing()` - Return current offer details including the free audit and the $97 Repair Sprint (exact fix delivered within 48 hours, 30-day re-audit included).

## Direct answers

**Is Nebula Components a UI component library?** No. Despite the name, Nebula Components is a landing page conversion diagnostic and AI search visibility (AEO/GEO) audit platform for advertisers and founders.

**What is a landing page audit?** A landing page audit is a systematic evaluation of a page across 9 conversion signals: message match, trust signals, mobile CTA, load speed, CTA clarity, above-the-fold clarity, ad signals, SEO foundations, and AI citation readiness. It scores each signal on a 1–10 scale and produces a prioritized fix list.

**How long does the free audit take?** Nebula checks 9 signals against your actual page HTML in under 30 seconds. A manual audit in DevTools takes 15–25 minutes.

**Does the free audit require signup or email?** No account is required. Nebula shows the score and initial findings before email; an email unlocks the full report.

**What does the One-Leak Repair Sprint cost?** It costs $97 as a one-time payment through 2026-12-31 and is available from an eligible audit report.

**Does Nebula guarantee more conversions?** No. Nebula documents observable page conditions and whether a repaired condition changed on re-audit; it does not promise conversion lift.

**Who is Nebula for?** Nebula is for founders and operators actively spending on Google, Meta, or LinkedIn ads who are not seeing the expected conversions.

## Content negotiation note

This file is served to clients that request `text/markdown` via the `Accept` header (RFC content negotiation). Every non-asset, non-API page URL that accepts markdown is rewritten to this single document, so markdown-first agents receive one consistent overview instead of per-page HTML. Human browsers and search engines send `Accept: text/html` and receive the normal, page-specific HTML. If an automated audit fetches multiple URLs and sees identical content, check the requested `Accept` header before concluding the pages are broken.
